title: Lesson 09: Megapixels
sources: Samsung Camera Photo mode: resolution picker 12M / 50M / 200M (creator's own screenshot); 12MP uses pixel binning for better low-light results and smaller files

lines.text: Is two hundred megapixels always better?
Tap the twelve M at the top to change resolution.
Twelve is the best everyday choice,
great in low light, with small files.
Fifty and two hundred capture huge detail in bright light,
perfect for crops and prints, but the files are massive.
So shoot twelve by default, and switch up for landscapes.
